title: The Best Budget Sheet Sets on Amazon
excerpt: Three best-selling queen sheet sets that feel more expensive than they are.

body.p: Pricey sheets can be lovely, but a well-made microfiber set gets you most of the way there for a fraction of the price. These three are among Amazon's top-ranked bedding, and each solves a different problem.
These sit near the top of Amazon's bedding charts for a reason. They feel smooth and cool, come in a huge range of colors and sizes, and keep their shape through repeated washing.

body.h: For the lowest price: Amazon Basics Microfiber

body.p: These are light, soft and wrinkle-resistant, so they come out of the dryer looking made-up. They fit mattresses up to 14" deep.
If fitted sheets keep popping off the corners of your bed, the 16" deep pockets on this set will fix it, even with a topper.

ul: Wash in cool or warm water, not hot, to avoid pilling.
Skip fabric softener on microfiber because it reduces breathability.
Rotate two sets so each gets a rest between washes.
